concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-latest-patch-registereddevices-id]] — 2026-11-03-captured Balance Platform API v2 TEST PATCH reference for finalizing SCA-device registration with a prior POST device ID, payment-instrument ID and SDK output; its optional `success` description says initiation despite the completion heading, while the Business Accounts guide checks for `success: true`.
warnings: The API completion wording and response field's initiation wording differ; preserve the qualification.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-latest-patch-registereddevices-id]] — 2026-11-03-captured Balance Platform API v2 TEST PATCH SCA-device-registration completion reference also applicable to Adyen-issued cards; the optional `success` field is worded as initiation, and the Issuing guide uses an explicit `success: true` check.
warnings: Do not treat bare 200 or omitted success as completed registration or a later card authentication outcome.
